headline: GPT-6 Astra shows safety research gaps amid new model releases
body: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model is underperforming on safety research tasks according to emerging reports, raising questions about model evaluation rigor as the vendor landscape accelerates release cycles. For healthcare AI implementations, safety validation gaps directly impact clinical decision support systems and EHR integrations where model failures carry patient safety implications. Healthcare organizations evaluating next-generation LLMs for clinical workflows need stronger third-party verification protocols beyond vendor claims. This situation underscores the consulting need to audit model safety profiles before deployment in regulated healthcare environments where transparency and reproducible testing are non-negotiable requirements.
